encoding: UTF-8; LF; no normalization or stripping of approved_body

registry.nodes_key: Exact approved alias string; after allocation exactly all871 aliases and no others

entry_exact_fields.number: positive JSON integer, never bool or float; GitHub issue number
entry_exact_fields.id: positive JSON integer, never bool or float; GitHub database issue ID
entry_exact_fields.node_id: nonempty string; GitHub GraphQL node ID

registry.identity_rules: All three identity fields unique across871 new issues; numbers disjoint from every baseline issue; final live graph/readback must bind every entry to the actual Issue, not a PR. Partial registry permitted only in ALLOCATING and never qualifies final proof.
registry.hash_rules: Pin approval and renderer contract hashes independently; do not accept a candidate supplied expected hash as the semantic oracle.

reference_resolution: ASCII decimal references resolve to that existing issue number; all other references are exact approved aliases and resolve through registry.nodes[alias].number. No fallback, substring or implicit future scope.
allocation_body: allocation_prefix_template.format(alias=alias) + approved_body; approved_body is copied byte-for-byte from approval.approved_nodes, not regenerated from mutable candidate claims
prerequisites_rendering: Resolve all approved blocked_by_refs to numbers, reject duplicate references/identities, sort ascending numerically. Render as comma-space joined #N values, or literal none for an empty list.
final_suffix_template:
<!-- edda-caster-native-binding:start -->
Decision: #{owner_decision}
Source key: {alias}
Native issue: #{number}
Native parent: #{parent_number}
Native prerequisites: {prerequisites}
Root approval SHA256: {approval_sha256}
Renderer contract SHA256: {renderer_contract_sha256}
Publication: source contract published; runtime unqualified.
<!-- edda-caster-native-binding:end -->
final_body: allocation_body + final_suffix_template filled ONLY from frozen approved node, pinned hashes and complete validated registry; no arbitrary append or override. Preserve trailing newlines of approved_body, even if this yields extra blank lines.
phase_policy: Use allocation_body before every alias has an ID. Use final_body only after complete registry validation. Existing allocated journal IDs must be retained; reconcile owned pending bodies if needed, never create duplicates to change marker format. No native mutation rights are granted to proof-only authors.
qualification: This format and registry are mechanical metadata only. They confer no source eligibility, runtime grant, Task completion, parent-prefix seal or PR/CI acceptance.
